events.title: MTV Celebrates Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: MTV, the iconic music television channel, first launched on August 1st, 1981, with The Buggles' "Video Killed The Radio Star" as its inaugural music video.

angles.name: MTV Launch
angles.copy: On this day in 1981, MTV burst onto our screens, changing music forever. Its first video? A classic that ironically predicted its own future.

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on August 15, 1969, in Bethel, New York, becoming a pivotal moment in music and cultural history.

angles.name: Woodstock Remembered
angles.copy: 57 years ago today, the legendary Woodstock Festival kicked off. Three days of peace, love, and music that defined a generation. What's your favourite Woodstock moment?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, passed away on August 16, 1977, leaving an indelible mark on music and pop culture.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the one and only King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who left us too soon in 1977. His legacy continues to inspire generations.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: American singer-songwriter Chrissie Hynde, frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! From The Pretenders' classics to her solo work, a true rock legend.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Alright! Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, "Dr. No," in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day
angles.copy: Grab your martini, shaken not stirred! It's James Bond Day, celebrating 007's big screen debut. What's your favourite Bond film?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon, a global icon of peace and music, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Thinking of John Lennon today, who would have been 86. His music and message of peace resonate just as strongly now.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Iconic British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy.
